comments.content: The function relies on the Node.js global `process` (process.stderr.write / process.exit). This file appears to live in a project that does NOT otherwise use `process` (no matches across *.ts files), and the file is positioned as a pure helper. Relying on an ambient Node `process` global without importing it (e.g. from '@std/process') or declaring the dependency is fragile: under stricter TS configs or non-Node targets (e.g. Deno, browser, edge) this will fail to compile or runtime. Import the dependency explicitly (e.g. `import { stderr, exit } from "@std/process";`) or, if this is intentionally Node-only, document/guard it so the dependency is explicit.
